verdicts.reason: A fills the canvas with a strong, readable headline, but its left edges don't line up (the headline starts at about x=64 while the logo and subhead start at about x=76). The headline also runs almost to the right edge with very little margin, and the CTA floats on its own on the right between the subhead and the chips, which spreads the reading order around. B has a cleaner single left edge and a sensible order (logo, headline, subhead, chips, CTA), but the headline wraps and leaves 'here' alone on its own line. All of B's content is packed into the top-left quarter, leaving the bottom-left and right half as dead space with only the decorative pink circle, so the layout is lopsided and the original's left-to-right feel is lost.
